domain: Autumn nature and foliage timing for Oct 17-25 2026

forecast_summary.definitions: Korea Forest Service (KFS, 산림청) 'peak' = ~50% of forest colored. KMA / Weather i (웨더아이) / KWeather (케이웨더) 'first color' = 20% of mountain colored, 'peak' = 80% colored. So KFS peak dates read earlier than Weather i peak dates for the same mountain.
forecast_summary.kfs_2026_map_released: 2026-09-22 (2026년 한반도 단풍절정 예측지도). Nationwide peak in late October; 0.8 days later than the 5-year average. Ginkgo nationwide average peak Oct 30; maples and oaks Oct 31.

weather_i_2026.published: early-mid Sept 2026; says first color and peak both later than normal because of a hot late September/October
weather_i_2026.Seoraksan: first Oct 3 (actually observed Sep 28 by KMA), peak Oct 25
weather_i_2026.Gayasan: first Oct 22 (9 days late), peak Nov 5 (9 days late)
weather_i_2026.Palgongsan: first Oct 26 (9 days late), peak Nov 12 (15 days late)

forecast_summary.kweather_2026: Seoraksan first color ~Sep 30 (2 days late); central first Sep 30-Oct 18, peak Oct 19-Nov 1; southern first Oct 19-27, peak Nov 1-11; Jirisan ~8 days late, Naejangsan ~7 days late (secondary-source summary, medium confidence).
forecast_summary.observed: KMA (Gangwon Regional Office) observed Seoraksan first foliage on Sep 28, 2026: same as normal, 4 days earlier than 2025 (Oct 2).
forecast_summary.bottom_line_for_oct_17_25: Best color during the trip is in high Gangwon mountains: Odaesan (peak ~Oct 16-20), Seoraksan (ridges Oct 15-20, valleys Oct 20-27; KFS peak Oct 20, Weather i Oct 25), plus Gapyeong gardens and Nami Island toward the end of the window. Seoul city, Gyeongju, Naejangsan, Gayasan, Palgongsan, Hallasan and Unmunsa will be early/partial color only (peaks late Oct to mid Nov). Silver grass (Haneul Park, Mingdongsan, Hwangmaesan, Ganwoljae, Saebyeol Oreum) is at or near peak. Pink muhly is past its peak (fading/brownish pink) by Oct 17-25.

places.name: Seoraksan National Park - Sogongwon to Biseondae valley walk
places.summary: Mostly flat, wide valley path from Sogongwon (Sinheungsa, giant bronze Buddha) along the Cheonbuldong stream to Biseondae rock pools under granite spires. About 3 km one way, 1 h each way; extendable 1 km uphill to Geumganggul cave (steep stairs) or further up Cheonbuldong valley toward Yangpok shelter (3-4 h round trip).
places.why: The single best moderate foliage walk in Korea for the trip window: granite peaks, clear stream, red/yellow maples. Analog to Kamakura's temple-in-nature feel (Sinheungsa) but far more dramatic.
places.autumn_note: Valley (Sogongwon/Biseondae, ~200-400 m) color peaks ~Oct 20-27 in 2026; ridges Oct 15-20. KFS peak Oct 20, Weather i Oct 25. Prime time exactly during the trip.
places.hours: Park entrance usually open from ~05:00-06:00 to ~19:00 in autumn; trail entry cut-off times apply to upper trails (check KNPS).
places.cost_note: No park/temple entrance fee (cultural heritage admission fees abolished May 2023). Parking at Seorak-dong ~5,000-7,000 KRW per car per day (unverified for 2026).
places.tips: Go on a weekday (Mon Oct 19-Thu Oct 22). Take Sokcho city bus 7 or 7-1 (20-40 min) from Sokcho terminal/downtown to the Seorak-dong terminus; arrive by 07:00-08:00 on peak days. Combine with the Gwongeumseong cable car (get the cable car ticket first, then walk to Biseondae while you wait).

places.name: Seoraksan - Ulsanbawi Rock hike (via Heundeulbawi rocking stone)
places.summary: Classic half-day climb from Sogongwon past Sinheungsa and Gyejoam hermitage/Heundeulbawi (rocking stone) to the 873 m granite massif. About 3.8 km one way; the last ~1 km is steep steel staircases (~800+ steps). Views to the East Sea and over Seorak's outer ridges.
places.why: Big payoff for moderately fit adults: sea-and-mountain panorama (a dramatic cousin to Kamakura's hill-to-sea views).
places.autumn_note: Lower forest colors ~Oct 18-27; the summit is rock so views of colored ridges are the draw.
places.hours: Trail entry cut-off typically early afternoon in autumn (KNPS posts seasonal entry limits; be on trail by ~12:00-13:00).
places.closed: Open daily except during weather warnings
places.tips: Start by 08:00. Stairs are narrow two-way; weekend queues on the stairs. Bring a windbreaker: summit wind is strong and temps can be 5-10 C colder than Sokcho.

places.name: Seorak Cable Car to Gwongeumseong Fortress
places.summary: 5-minute cable car (10 min round trip) from Sogongwon to a rocky summit near Gwongeumseong fortress ruins, then ~15-20 min scramble on bare rock for 360-degree views of Seorak's spires.
places.why: Lowest-effort way to see Seorak's peaks in color; good for a mixed-energy group.
places.autumn_note: Views of the colored ridges are best Oct 15-25.
places.hours: Varies daily with weather and conditions; check the homepage on the day. Roughly 08:00/08:30 to ~17:00-18:00 in October (unverified).
places.cost_note: Adult round trip 16,000 KRW, child 12,000 KRW (official guide). One-way tickets not sold. Senior discount not available Sep 19-Nov 15, 2026.
places.booking: Same-day on-site ticket only; no online/advance booking. Ticket shows an assigned boarding time. Refund allowed until 10 min before departure (20% fee after).
places.tips: Notorious queue problem: on autumn weekends boarding times printed on tickets can be 2-4 hours out or sell out by late morning. Buy tickets at opening, then walk to Biseondae while waiting. Weekday is strongly preferred. Live info: Tel 033-636-4300.

places.name: Seoraksan Nam(South)-seorak: Heullimgol to Jujeongol valley traverse
places.summary: One-way traverse, mostly downhill after a steep first section: Heullimgol trailhead (on Route 44 below Hangyeryeong pass) - Yeosim falls - Deungseondae viewpoint - Sibi (Twelve) falls - Yongso falls junction - Jujeongol gorge - Osaek. About 6 km, 3.5-4.5 h. Jujeongol alone (Osaek to Yongso falls and back, ~3 km each way, nearly flat) is the easy option.
places.why: Considered the most colorful canyon in Seoraksan in autumn: red maples against narrow granite gorge and waterfalls. Ends at Osaek mineral springs village (onsen-town analog to Izu).
places.autumn_note: Jujeongol/Heullimgol typically peak in the last third of October; good fit for Oct 19-25, 2026.
places.time_needed: Half day (3.5-4.5 h traverse) or 2 h for Jujeongol round trip from Osaek
places.hours: Trail entry limited to morning/early afternoon (check KNPS).
places.closed: Heullimgol was closed ~2015-2024 after a rockfall; it reopened in 2024 and has operated with an advance reservation system in peak autumn. Status for Oct 2026 not verified.
places.cost_note: Free; taxi from Osaek back to Heullimgol trailhead ~10-15 min.
places.booking: Heullimgol section: verify on KNPS reservation site (reservation.knps.or.kr) whether 2026 autumn reservation applies (it did in recent seasons). Jujeongol from Osaek: no reservation.
places.tips: Intercity buses Seoul (Dong Seoul) - Osaek - Yangyang stop on Route 44; or taxi from Sokcho/Yangyang (~40 min). Very crowded on weekends with tour buses.

places.name: Odaesan National Park - Woljeongsa fir forest path and Seonjae-gil
places.summary: Woljeongsa temple's 1 km fir-tree avenue (flat, 20-30 min) plus Seonjae-gil, a gentle streamside forest trail of ~9 km from Woljeongsa to Sangwonsa temple (~3-3.5 h one way, very small elevation gain). Can walk any portion and return by bus between Woljeongsa and Sangwonsa.
places.why: Gentle 'temple pilgrimage path' feel like Kamakura's temple walks, with a big Zen-style monastery and wooden bridges; zero technical difficulty.
places.autumn_note: Odaesan peak: Weather i Oct 16; other summaries Oct 17-20. The lower Seonjae-gil valley is typically a few days behind the summit, so Oct 17-21 should be at or just past peak; one of the safest bets for color on the trip.
places.hours: Daylight; Woljeongsa open early morning to evening.
places.cost_note: Temple admission abolished in May 2023; parking at Woljeongsa ~5,000-6,000 KRW (unverified).
places.tips: KTX Seoul/Cheongnyangni to Jinbu (Odaesan) station, then local bus to Woljeongsa/Sangwonsa (~25-40 min) or taxi. Woljeongsa parking fills by ~10:00 on autumn weekends; weekday visit preferred. Woljeongsa also runs a templestay.

places.name: Chiaksan National Park - Guryongsa valley
places.summary: Easy valley walk from the Guryong entrance to Guryongsa temple (~1 km) and on to Seryeom falls (~3 km one way, 1.5-2 h round trip). The summit Birobong is a hard climb, not recommended.
places.why: Accessible from Seoul (KTX to Wonju) but color will be early during the trip.
places.autumn_note: Weather i peak Oct 31; KWeather central peak Oct 19-Nov 1. Expect first color/partial only Oct 17-25.
places.tips: Lower priority than Odaesan/Seoraksan for this trip.

places.name: Bukhansan National Park - Baegundae via Bukhansanseong
places.summary: Seoul's signature granite summit (836 m). Popular route: Bukhansanseong Visitor Center - Daeseomun - Wonhyobong junction - Wiryeongmun - Baegundae, ~4.2 km one way, 2.5 h up, 2 h down. Final 300 m is bare rock with steel cables. Easier option: Ui-dong - Baegundae shelter route (shorter, steeper) or just the lower valley to Jungseongmun.
places.why: Mountain hike inside a megacity; summit view over Seoul's sprawl (Shibuya-scale city seen from wild granite).
places.autumn_note: 2026 Bukhansan forecasts vary: first color Oct 15-23, peak Oct 28-30 (secondary summaries) or Nov 4 (Weather i/KTO). Upper slopes partial color Oct 20-25; lower valleys still mostly green.
places.hours: Trails open ~04:00-sunset; summit-bound entry cut-off about 2 h before sunset (KNPS rule).
places.tips: Bus 704/34 from Gupabal station (Line 3) to Bukhansanseong entrance (~10 min). Weekend summit queues on the cable section can be 30-60 min; go on a weekday morning. Needs proper shoes.

places.name: Seoul City Wall Trail - Baegaksan (Bugaksan) and Inwangsan sections
places.summary: Baegak section: Changuimun gate - Baegak summit (342 m) - Sukjeongmun - Malbawi - Waryong park / Hyehwamun, ~4.7 km, 2.5-3 h, many stairs. Inwang section: Changuimun / Yun Dong-ju Literature Museum - Inwangsan summit (338 m) - Sajik park, ~2.5 km, 1.5-2 h. Whole of Bugaksan has been open to the public since April 2022.
places.why: Walk a 600-year-old Joseon fortress wall above Gyeongbokgung and the Blue House with the whole city (incl. Namsan Tower) below; a 'city meets nature' half-day close to downtown.
places.autumn_note: Seoul-area foliage in 2026 runs late; expect early color (sumac, cherry leaves) Oct 20-25 with Seoul's main peak ~late Oct to early Nov. Inwangsan at sunset (17:43-17:53) is excellent regardless.
places.hours: Baegak section has seasonal entry hours (roughly 07:00-17:00 in Nov-Feb, longer Mar-Oct, check). Inwangsan open at all times.
places.closed: Baegak section: Mondays historically (verify; may have changed since full opening)
places.cost_note: Free; no ID or permit required since 2022.
places.tips: Bus 7212/1020/7022 to Jahamun Pass (Changuimun). Combine Inwangsan sunset with Seochon dinner. Good on a weekend because it doesn't need traffic.

places.name: Haneul Park (World Cup Park) silver grass fields - Seoul Eulalia Festival
places.summary: Former landfill turned ~200,000 m2 hilltop grassland of silver grass (억새) above the Han River. The 25th Seoul Eulalia Festival 2026 runs Oct 17-23 with evening lighting, photo zones, busking and a recycled-crafts market.
places.why: Iconic Seoul autumn scene; festival dates line up exactly with the trip; night opening means it can be combined with a day elsewhere.
places.autumn_note: Silver grass at peak silver plumes mid-to-late October; best light 1 h before sunset (~16:45-17:50).
places.hours: Festival Oct 17-23, 2026: 10:00-21:00 (extended night opening). Outside festival, Haneul Park closes around sunset.
places.cost_note: Free. 'Maengkkongi' electric cart from Nanji-cheon Park parking lot up the hill (small fare, ~2,000-3,000 KRW; not confirmed for 2026), or climb the 291-step Haneul staircase (~15 min).
places.tips: Subway Line 6 World Cup Stadium Station (exit 1), ~20 min walk to the stairs (official says ~40 min to the fields). Avoid weekend afternoons (Oct 17-18); weekday evening is best. Contact 02-300-5574.

places.name: Seoul city foliage: Changdeokgung Huwon, Deoksugung stone-wall road, Namsan, Seoul Forest
places.name_ko: 창덕궁 후원 · 덕수궁 돌담길 · 남산 · 서울숲
places.summary: Seoul's classic urban autumn walks: the Secret Garden (Huwon) of Changdeokgung (guided tour), the Deoksugung stone-wall road (ginkgo and zelkova lined), Namsan's north-side walking path and Namsan Tower, and Seoul Forest's ginkgo and deer park.
places.why: Palace-and-garden foliage closest to the Kamakura temple-garden feel within Seoul.
places.autumn_note: These peak late: Seoul maples typically late Oct-early Nov and ginkgo ~early-mid Nov; KFS national ginkgo average Oct 30 and Bukhansan peak Nov 4 (Weather i) imply Seoul city is mostly green-to-early-color on Oct 17-25. Huwon maples are usually the earliest in central Seoul (late Oct).
places.time_needed: Huwon tour 90 min; each walk 1-2 h
places.hours: Changdeokgung 09:00-18:00 (Feb-May, Sep-Oct; last entry 17:00); Huwon tours by time slot.
places.closed: Changdeokgung closed Mondays; Deoksugung closed Mondays; Gyeongbokgung closed Tuesdays.
places.cost_note: Changdeokgung 3,000 KRW + Huwon 5,000 KRW (verify 2026). Deoksugung 1,000 KRW; Namsan, Seoul Forest free.
places.booking: Huwon: online booking opens about 6 days ahead on the Changdeokgung site; foreigners can book; some same-day tickets on site.
places.tips: Treat Seoul foliage as a bonus; prioritize Gangwon for color.

places.name: Nami Island
places.summary: Half-moon river island reached by ferry or zipline, famous for tree-lined avenues (Songpa ginkgo road, metasequoia lane, red maples).
places.why: Very popular, photogenic tree avenues; easy to pair with the Garden of Morning Calm on a Gapyeong day.
places.autumn_note: Typical peak window Oct 20-Nov 5; in a late 2026 season the ginkgo road is likely best ~Oct 28-Nov 5, so on Oct 23-25 expect mixed green/yellow with red maples starting.
places.cost_note: Admission incl. round-trip ferry ~16,000 KRW adult (2025 price; 2026 not verified). Zipline ~50,000 KRW.
places.booking: Walk-up ferry ticket at Gapyeong wharf; zipline book ahead.
places.tips: Arrive before 09:30 or after 15:00 to avoid tour-bus crowds; weekends extremely busy. ITX-Cheongchun Yongsan/Cheongnyangni to Gapyeong, then taxi (~5 min) or Gapyeong tour bus.

places.name: The Garden of Morning Calm
places.summary: Large private garden in a mountain bowl with Korean-style gardens, a bonsai garden, chrysanthemum displays, and a maple-lined valley.
places.why: Most 'Japanese garden'-like foliage experience near Seoul; elevation (~400-650 m) means it colors earlier than Seoul.
places.autumn_note: Usually best mid-to-late October, a week or so ahead of Nami Island; good fit Oct 18-25, 2026. Autumn chrysanthemum exhibition typically runs through October.
places.cost_note: Adult ~11,000-12,000 KRW (2025 level; official site did not load, 2026 unverified).
places.booking: Walk-up; online discount tickets on Korean platforms.
places.tips: Gapyeong tour bus or taxi from Cheongpyeong/Gapyeong station (~25-30 min). Winter light festival starts in December, not relevant.

places.name: Hwadam Botanic Garden (Hwadamsup)
places.summary: LG-funded forest garden on a hillside with 400+ maple varieties on a gently sloping deck path (~5 km loop) plus a monorail.
places.why: The most refined maple-garden experience in Korea, close to a Kyoto-style momiji garden.
places.autumn_note: 2026 autumn peak season runs Oct 23-Nov 15; maple peak usually late Oct-early Nov. Only Oct 23-25 of the trip falls inside the season.
places.hours: Oct 23-Nov 1: 08:00-18:00 (last entry 17:00); Nov 2-15: 08:00-17:00 (last entry 16:00). No closing days during peak season.
places.closed: Normally Mondays, but no closure days during the Oct 23-Nov 15 peak season
places.cost_note: Adult 11,000 KRW; monorail extra: station 1-2 5,000, 1-3 7,000, full loop 9,000 KRW.
places.booking: 100% advance online booking by time slot (no on-site sales) on NOL (Yanolja/Interpark platform); booking opened Sep 16, 2026 13:00. Free cancel until 23:59 the day before; 30% fee same day. Weekend slots and monorail sell out; foreign-card/foreigner booking may require Interpark Global/NOL global - verify.
places.tips: Konjiam station (Gyeonggang line) then resort shuttle/taxi (~10 min). Book a weekday slot (Fri Oct 23) and the monorail at the same time.

places.name: Mingdongsan silver grass ridge
places.summary: Bald 1,119 m summit covered by ~660,000 m2 (200,000 pyeong) of silver grass. Main route from Jeungsan Elementary School (near Mingdongsan station) ~1.5 h up via the shelter; allow 3-4 h total.
places.why: Vast rolling silver-grass ridge with mountain views; the most dramatic eulalia hike in Korea.
places.autumn_note: Festival Sep 18-Nov 8, 2026; silver grass fullest mid-to-late October, so on peak for the trip.
places.time_needed: 3-4 h hike, plus long travel (~3 h each way from Seoul)
places.tips: Vehicle access to the Balgudeok area is fully closed during the festival and the linked shuttle stopped; park at Mingdongsan sports complex or Neungjeon lot. Remote: only worth it if routing through Jeongseon/Gangwon.

places.name: Yeongnam Alps - Ganwoljae and Sinbulsan silver grass plains
places.summary: Silver grass saddle at ~900 m between Ganwolsan and Sinbulsan. Easiest approach: Baenaegol / Ganwoljae forest road (~5.5 km gentle road walk, 2 h up) or steeper Ganwol valley trail from Deungeok (~2.5-3 h up). Sinbulsan plateau above has 1.98 km2 of grass.
places.why: Huge golden grass ridges; good if the itinerary includes Gyeongju/Busan/Ulsan.
places.autumn_note: Silver grass peaks early to late October; on peak during trip. Ulju Odyssey concert held Oct 3, 2026 (past).
places.tips: Bus from Ulsan/Eonyang to Deungeok/Yeongnam Alps Complex Welcome Center; taxi easier. Weekend crowds and parking full by 09:00.

places.name: Hwangmaesan silver grass
places.summary: High plateau (~800-900 m) reached by car; short walks through silver grass with views. Known for spring azaleas and autumn silver grass.
places.why: Silver grass with minimal hiking, but very remote from Seoul.
places.autumn_note: Typically peaks early-to-late October (2026 festival dates not verified).
places.tips: Car required. Low priority for this route.

places.name: Saebyeol Oreum
places.summary: 519 m volcanic cone covered in silver grass; steep 30-40 min climb to the top and loop down. Sunset views to the sea.
places.why: Jeju's signature autumn silver-grass landscape; volcanic scenery akin to Izu's coastal hills.
places.autumn_note: Silver grass peaks mid-October to mid-November; on peak during trip (2026 not specifically confirmed).
places.tips: Windy; go near sunset (~17:50-18:00 Jeju). Car or taxi needed.

places.name: Hallasan - Yeongsil trail to Witse Oreum
places.summary: Most scenic non-summit Hallasan trail: ~5.8 km one way (from Yeongsil parking; 3.7 km from the upper trailhead) past Byeongpungbawi cliffs to Witse Oreum shelter, ~2.5 h up. No reservation needed (only Seongpanak and Gwaneumsa summit routes require one).
places.why: Volcano walk with alpine shrubs and sea views.
places.autumn_note: KFS Hallasan peak Nov 6 (1100 m point Nov 6), Weather i Nov 13. Upper-elevation shrubs (~1,400-1,700 m) can color by late October; lower forests still green.
places.tips: Only if the itinerary includes Jeju.

places.name: Naejangsan National Park
places.summary: Korea's most famous maple tunnel to Naejangsa temple.
places.why: Famous, but timing is wrong for this trip.
places.autumn_note: Peak Nov 4 (KFS) / Nov 11 (Weather i); first color ~Oct 20-27. Not worth it Oct 17-25.
places.tips: Skip for this trip.

places.name: Jirisan National Park - Piagol valley
places.summary: Valley famous for red maples; Jikjeon village to Piagol shelter ~4 km one way, ~2 h up. Alternatively drive to Seongsamjae/Nogodan (1,507 m) for ridge views (Nogodan summit by reservation).
places.why: Classic Jirisan red valley, but remote and timing marginal.
places.autumn_note: KFS Jirisan peak Oct 27; Weather i first Oct 28, peak Nov 5. Upper Piagol could show good color Oct 24-25; lower valley later.
places.tips: Low priority; long transfer.

places.name: Juwangsan National Park - Daejeonsa to Yongchu Falls, and Jusanji pond
places.summary: Easy flat gorge walk from Daejeonsa temple to Yongchu waterfall (~2 km, 40 min each way) between sheer cliffs; Jusanji is a nearby pond with 150-year-old willows standing in water (misty at dawn).
places.why: Cinematic gorge and pond scenery; feasible from Gyeongju/Andong by car (~1.5 h).
places.autumn_note: KFS Juwangsan peak Oct 26; expect strong color at Jusanji and the gorge Oct 22-25.
places.tips: Car needed realistically. Very crowded on weekends; Cheongsong is also known for apples (harvest season).

places.name: Gayasan National Park - Haeinsa and Sorigil
places.summary: Haeinsa temple (UNESCO Tripitaka Koreana) and the 6 km Sorigil valley path to it (~2 h one way, gentle).
places.why: Great temple + valley walk, but color will be early.
places.autumn_note: Weather i first Oct 22, peak Nov 5 (9 days late). Mostly pre-peak during trip.
places.tips: Day trip from Daegu (bus ~1.5 h).

places.name: Palgongsan - Donghwasa and the Palgongsan ring road
places.summary: Daegu's big mountain (national park since 2023); maple-lined loop road, Donghwasa temple, cable car to Sinmubong.
places.why: Accessible from Daegu, but late this year.
places.autumn_note: KFS peak Oct 30; Weather i first Oct 26 (9 days late), peak Nov 12 (15 days late). Pre-peak during trip.
places.tips: Skip unless passing through Daegu.

places.name: Gyeongju autumn: Bulguksa maples, Tongiljeon ginkgo road, Gyerim forest, Cheomseongdae fields
places.name_ko: 경주 불국사 · 통일전 은행나무길 · 계림 · 첨성대 핑크뮬리
places.summary: Bulguksa's maple-framed stone bridges; the ginkgo avenue to Tongiljeon (lat 35.804, lon 129.253 approx.); Gyerim's ancient zelkova grove; Cheomseongdae observatory surrounded by pink muhly, silver grass and cosmos fields (35.8347, 129.2190).
places.why: Kamakura analog city (ancient capital, temples, walkable heritage). Great regardless of peak color.
places.autumn_note: Gyeongju maples/ginkgo usually peak ~Nov 1-10 (Tongiljeon ginkgo early Nov); expect early yellowing only Oct 17-25. Cheomseongdae pink muhly was forecast to fully bloom in early October and stays viewable 'for about a month', so by Oct 17-25 it is late-season (fading). Gyerim zelkovas turn ~late Oct-early Nov.
places.hours: Bulguksa ~07:00-18:00 (Mar-Oct); Cheomseongdae/Gyerim area open always (night lighting).
places.tips: Shift expectations to heritage + early color; the Bomun lake cherry trees turn red earlier (late Oct).

places.name: Unmunsa temple 450-year-old ginkgo
places.summary: Bhikkhuni (nuns') monastery with a huge ginkgo inside the closed sangha college; opened to the public only ~2 days a year when golden. Also an ancient drooping pine and a pine-lined approach.
places.why: Special-access temple moment; but dates fall after the trip.
places.autumn_note: 2025 opening was Nov 8-9 (13:00-16:00). 2026 dates not announced as of Oct 6; almost certainly early-mid November, i.e. after the trip. Temple itself is still visitable.
places.closed: Ginkgo courtyard closed except the 2 opening days
places.tips: Skip for ginkgo; only worth it as a quiet temple stop.

places.name: Yangju Nari Park (globe amaranth + pink muhly)
places.summary: ~66,000 m2 flower farm with 10 million globe amaranth, pink muhly and 20+ autumn flowers.
places.why: Pink-field photo stop near Seoul, but late in its season during the trip.
places.autumn_note: Park open Sep 18-Oct 25, 2026; festival weekends Sep 26-28 and Oct 3-4; flowers peak Sep 25-Oct 10. By Oct 17-25 it is fading, last days before closing.
places.closed: Closes for the season after Oct 25, 2026
places.cost_note: ~5,000 KRW, refunded as local voucher (per 2025-2026 reports; verify).
places.tips: Not recommended for this trip.

places.name: Daejeo Ecological Park (pink muhly, pampas)
places.summary: Huge riverside park with pink muhly beside parking lot 2, pampas grass and silver grass along a bamboo path.
places.why: Free, easy; pampas/silver grass still good in late Oct even when muhly fades.
places.autumn_note: Pink muhly Sep-early/mid Oct; past peak by Oct 17-25. Pampas and silver grass fine.
places.tips: Busan Gimhae Light Rail Daejeo station nearby. Low priority.

transport.from: Seoul (Seoul Express Bus Terminal or Dong Seoul)
transport.duration: ~2 h 10 min-2 h 40 min weekdays; 3.5-5 h on autumn weekends
transport.booking: Kobus / T-money bus apps; foreigners can book via the English sites.
transport.notes: Price approx. (general ~19,000-23,000; premium ~30,000); not verified for 2026. Weekend Seoul-Yangyang Expressway foliage traffic is severe Saturday morning outbound and Sunday afternoon inbound.

transport.booking: Korail / Let's Korail; foreigners can book (Korail English site or Korail Pass)
transport.notes: Price approx. Then local bus/taxi 25-40 min to Woljeongsa/Sangwonsa; taxi ~20,000 KRW to Woljeongsa (estimate).

transport.to: Gapyeong (Nami Island, Garden of Morning Calm)
transport.notes: Approx. fare; Gyeongchun line subway is cheaper and slower. Gapyeong city tour bus loops Nami / Petite France / Garden of Morning Calm.

events.name: 25th Seoul Eulalia (Silver Grass) Festival
events.notes: Opening ceremony with lighting show, silver-grass crafts, photo zones, busking, recycled-goods market. Line 6 World Cup Stadium or Mapo-gu Office stations. Tel 02-300-5574.

events.name: Jeongseon Mingdongsan Silver Grass Festival
events.notes: Vehicle access to Balgudeok closed throughout; no shuttle.

events.name: Hwadam Botanic Garden autumn peak season (timed-entry)
events.booking: Online only via NOL; opened Sep 16, 2026
events.notes: No closure days in peak season.

weather.seoul_october_normals: Oct mean daily max 20.2 C, min 10.6 C, 52 mm rain on ~4.8 days (1991-2020). Mid-late October: highs ~17-21 C, lows ~7-12 C. November drops to max 11.9 C / min 3.5 C.
weather.seoraksan_odaesan: Valleys (Sogongwon ~200 m, Woljeongsa ~600 m): highs ~14-19 C, early-morning lows ~3-8 C; high ridges/Ulsanbawi summit windy, can be near 0 C in the morning, first frost common late October. Pack fleece + windbreaker.
weather.2026_outlook: Forecasters (Weather i, KWeather) expected above-normal temperatures in late September-October 2026, the reason foliage is running several days late in the south and center.

tips: Put the Gangwon mountains (Seoraksan, Odaesan) on weekdays Mon Oct 19-Thu Oct 22: that is where peak color will be during the trip, and weekdays avoid cable-car sellouts and expressway jams.
Order that matches the color front: Odaesan first (peak ~Oct 16-20), then Seoraksan valleys (Oct 20-27), then Gapyeong/Hwadam (Oct 23-25+).
Use Seoul's Haneul Park silver grass festival (Oct 17-23, open until 21:00) for an easy jet-lag-day activity on arrival day or an evening.
For Seorak Cable Car: be at the ticket booth at opening, take the printed boarding time, and hike to Biseondae (1 h each way) while waiting.
Hwadam Botanic Garden must be booked online in advance for Oct 23-25 (no on-site tickets); book entry and monorail together.
Temple admission fees at Sinheungsa, Woljeongsa, Bulguksa, Haeinsa etc. have been free since May 2023, so foliage hikes cost almost nothing except transport and cable cars.
KNPS autumn wildfire-prevention trail closures normally start Nov 15 (to Dec 15), so they do not affect Oct 17-25; individual high-ridge sections can still close for weather.
Check real-time foliage at KMA's 'famous mountain foliage' observation page and the KNPS/Seoraksan live cams the evening before each mountain day.
warnings: Weekend foliage traffic: Sat Oct 17/24 outbound and Sun Oct 18/25 inbound on the Seoul-Yangyang and Yeongdong expressways can double bus times; avoid scheduling Seoraksan on a weekend, and do not return from Gangwon on Sun Oct 25 afternoon given the 21:55 ICN flight.
Seorak Cable Car is same-day on-site sale only; some blogs wrongly say advance booking is required. On autumn weekends tickets can sell out by late morning.
Seoul city, Gyeongju, Naejangsan, Gayasan, Palgongsan, Hallasan and Unmunsa will NOT be at peak during Oct 17-25, 2026; set expectations to early color.
Pink muhly everywhere (Cheomseongdae, Nari Park, Daejeo, Jeju) peaks late Sept-early Oct and is fading by the trip; Nari Park closes Oct 25.
Unmunsa's ginkgo courtyard opens only ~2 days in early-mid November (2025: Nov 8-9); dates for 2026 not announced and almost certainly after the trip.
Heullimgol (South Seorak) autumn reservation status for 2026 unverified; check KNPS reservation before planning the traverse.
